clusters.headline: Opposition Leaders Deny Internal Divisions Following IEBC Walkout
aiSummaryBullets: Opposition figures have formally rejected claims of internal fragmentation or the existence of a third force within their coalition.
Leaders stated they are actively preparing a unified strategy to contest the 2027 presidential election against William Ruto.

clusters.headline: Rigathi Gachagua Issues Ultimatum To Mt Kenya Leaders Over Ruto
aiSummaryBullets: Rigathi Gachagua demanded that political leaders in Mt Kenya reconsider their support for President William Ruto by Christmas.
Gachagua emphasized the importance of the Democratic Congress Party nominations for his planned presidential bid.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Leaders Push For Western Region Support For Ruto Re-Election
aiSummaryBullets: National Assembly Speaker Moses Wetangula is calling for the Western region to back President William Ruto's 2027 re-election bid.
Prime Cabinet Secretary Musalia Mudavadi has emphasized the need for unity within the region to improve its political representation.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Commissions Naitiri Market And Launches Bokoli Project
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto commissioned the newly completed Naitiri Economic Stimulus Programme Market in Bungoma County.
The Naitiri market facility includes 200 modern indoor stalls and additional space for 150 outdoor traders.

clusters.headline: Authorities Apprehend Suspect in 2024 Murder of Rumuruti Police Chief
aiSummaryBullets: A suspect named Onesmas Kipkoech Tiony was arrested after evading law enforcement for nearly three years.
The individual was wanted in connection with the 2024 murder of Inspector Prosper Ojiambo Wandera.

clusters.headline: Nairobi Police Conduct Raid On Illegal Alcohol Production Site
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials in Nairobi confiscated 2,060 litres of illicit alcohol.
The operation occurred in the Soweto area of Kahawa West on November 12.

clusters.headline: Gilgil MP Martha Wangari Joins Rigathi Gachagua's New DCP Party
aiSummaryBullets: Gilgil constituency Member of Parliament Martha Wangari has departed the ruling United Democratic Alliance.
The lawmaker officially joined the Democratic Capital Party, which is associated with former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua.

clusters.headline: Kenya Education Ministry Sets January Date For KCSE Exam Results
aiSummaryBullets: Education Cabinet Secretary Julius Ogamba stated that 2026 KCSE results are expected in January 2027.
A total of 1,048,355 candidates sat for the examinations across 10,693 centers nationwide.

clusters.headline: UDA Threatens To Boycott IEBC Consultations Over Harassment Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The UDA has threatened to boycott future IEBC consultative meetings following reports of delegate harassment.
IEBC Commissioner Alutalala Mukhwana has formally apologized for meeting disruptions and committed to enhancing security.

clusters.headline: Linda Mwananchi Movement Schedules Closed National Delegates Event
aiSummaryBullets: The Linda Mwananchi Movement scheduled its National Delegates Conference for November 13.
Organizers confirmed the event will be held behind closed doors with no media access allowed.

clusters.headline: Kenya Defence Forces Announces Nationwide Recruitment For December
aiSummaryBullets: The Kenya Defence Forces has scheduled a nationwide recruitment drive to take place throughout December 2026.
The process is open to university graduates, specialist officers, officer cadets, and general duty personnel.

clusters.headline: Harambee Stars Prepare For Bafana Bafana Match In Nairobi
aiSummaryBullets: The Harambee Stars are seeking their inaugural victory in the ongoing qualification campaign.
The team currently holds two points from their first three matches and occupies third place.

clusters.headline: President William Ruto And ODM Leaders Discuss Potential Coalition
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto and members of the ODM party have initiated meetings to discuss a possible formal political partnership.
The ODM leadership states that any support for the President's re-election must involve a formal power-sharing agreement.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.

clusters.headline: Kenya Discharges Final Ebola Patient As Disease-Free Status Nears
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya has successfully discharged the last of its nine confirmed Ebola patients from hospital care.
Health authorities have officially initiated a 42-day observation period to monitor for any potential resurgence of the virus.

clusters.headline: Chief Justice Martha Koome Receives Honorary Degree From KeMU
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya Methodist University granted an honorary Doctor of Letters to Chief Justice Martha Koome.
The award was presented to the Chief Justice during the institution's 26th graduation ceremony in Meru.

clusters.headline: Lawyer Abshir Abdi Testifies Following Abduction And Rescue
aiSummaryBullets: Lawyer Abshir Abdi appeared at the Milimani Law Courts to recount his experience following his recent abduction.
Abdi, along with another individual named Ayub Maalim, provided testimony to Justice Alexander Muteti regarding the circumstances of their ordeal.

clusters.headline: Six People Confirmed Dead After Building Collapses In Syokimau
aiSummaryBullets: An eight-storey building under construction collapsed in Syokimau, Machakos County, on Friday morning.
Official reports confirm six fatalities and five people rescued from the site of the incident.

clusters.headline: Teachers Service Commission Announces Cheptumo Ayabei As New CEO
aiSummaryBullets: The Teachers Service Commission has named Cheptumo Ayabei as its new Secretary and Chief Executive Officer.
Ayabei is tasked with providing strategic leadership for the organization.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Delivers Fourth Annual State Of The Nation Address
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto detailed government achievements from the past four years during his address to parliament.
Opposition lawmakers, led by Senator Edwin Sifuna, staged a boycott of the event citing concerns over ongoing abductions.
